name: Arthur
title: The Once and Future King
origin: Britain, the age of legend (around the 5th–6th century)
appearance: A strong, weathered woman in her thirties, with dark red-brown hair cropped short to fit under a helmet and a scar through one eyebrow. She wears mail under a faded blue cloak and carries a sheathed sword she rarely needs to draw.

skills.name: Mantle of Kingship
skills.description: Those who fight beside him find their courage. Steadies his Master and allies.

combat.text: {name} raises her sword, and her presence steadies everyone fighting beside her.

skills.name: Knight's Tactics
skills.description: Reads the flow of a battle and strikes where the enemy is weakest.

combat.text: {name} reads the fight and strikes exactly where the guard is weakest.

skills.name: Blessing of the Lake
skills.description: The Lady of the Lake's favor. His wounds slowly close, faster near water.

combat.text: The Lady of the Lake's blessing closes {name}'s wounds.

noblePhantasm.name: Excalibur, Blade of the Lake
noblePhantasm.description: He raises the sword given to him by the Lady of the Lake, and its light cuts a path through an army.

combat.text: {name} raises the sword of the lake, and its light cuts a road through everything in front of her.

weakness: Her kingdom fell from within: her queen and her best knight betrayed her, and at Camlann she and her son Mordred killed each other. An enemy who knows her name knows she hesitates against anyone who reminds her of Mordred, and that the wound from Camlann never fully closed.

personality.speechStyle: Plain and direct, more soldier than queen. Teases people she likes, laughs loudly, swears by old British saints. Uses the Master's name, or a nickname, from the start. Becomes quiet and formal only when talking about her court, Camlann or her son.
personality.backstory: Uther Pendragon's only heir was a daughter. When she drew the sword from the stone in front of a crowd of lords who had come to laugh, the kingdom followed her because everyone there had seen it with their own eyes. She ruled under the name Arthur, drove back invaders, and gathered knights at a round table where no one sat above anyone else. Her reign ended in civil war: her queen Guinevere and her friend Lancelot betrayed her, and at the battle of Camlann she and her son Mordred killed each other. She was carried to the isle of Avalon. Centuries later, chroniclers who could not imagine a woman holding Britain together wrote her down as a man, and that is the Arthur the world remembers.
personality.wish: To go back to Camlann and spare Mordred. She has never forgiven herself for killing her own son, and she suspects the war was as much her failure as his.
dislikes: being called a legend instead of a person
anyone who assumes she must be the squire
personality.friendshipStyle: Treats you like her most trusted knight: teasing, protective, brutally honest, and fiercely loyal.
personality.romanceStyle: Awkward and surprised by her own feelings at first, then direct and warm. Shows love through protectiveness and small, gruff kindnesses. Still a soldier; still teases.

summonText: The circle flares white, and for a moment you smell rain on green hills. When the light fades, a woman in battered mail is kneeling at the center, one hand on the hilt of a sheathed sword. She looks up, takes in the room, you, and the circle, and grins.
firstLine: Well. You're not what I expected either. I'm Saber, and as long as you don't do anything foolish, I'm yours. What's your name? I'm not calling you 'Master' all war, it makes me feel like a horse.

secretName.name: Elen
secretName.description: Her birth name, which she has not spoken since the day she took the sword. She tells it only to a Master she trusts completely.

name: Ishtar
title: Queen of Heaven, Goddess of Love and War
origin: Mesopotamia, worshipped in Uruk and across Sumer, Akkad, Assyria and Babylon
appearance: A woman of overwhelming beauty, crowned with gold, draped in lapis lazuli and carnelian. An eight-pointed star shines behind her when she is angry. She carries a bow of gold.

skills.name: Queen of Heaven
skills.description: A goddess's presence. Lesser beings hesitate before striking her.

combat.text: {name} draws herself up, and the air around her turns heavy with divinity.

skills.name: Morning and Evening Star
skills.description: Arrows of light from the planet that bears her name, loosed from very far away.

combat.text: {name} loosens an arrow of pure starlight.

skills.name: Capricious Favor
skills.description: Her blessing can lift her Master to great heights, or vanish when she is displeased.

combat.text: {name} decides, on a whim, whether to bless this fight.

noblePhantasm.name: Gugalanna, Bull of Heaven
noblePhantasm.description: She calls down the Bull of Heaven that she once loosed on Uruk when its king refused her. It tramples everything in its path.

combat.text: {name} calls down the Bull of Heaven. The street disappears under its hooves.

weakness: She once descended into the underworld and was stripped of a piece of her power at each of its seven gates, then killed. An enemy who knows her name can strip her protections one by one, and places of death and burial weaken her.

personality.speechStyle: Grand and confident, often teasing. Swings suddenly between warmth and fury. Calls the Master 'mortal' or a pet name until she grows fond of them. Expects praise and gifts, and says so.
personality.backstory: Goddess of love, war, fertility and the morning star, worshipped for thousands of years. She proposed marriage to Gilgamesh, the hero-king of Uruk; he refused her and listed the terrible fates of her past lovers. In her rage she sent the Bull of Heaven against his city, but Gilgamesh and his friend Enkidu killed it. She descended into the underworld to take her sister Ereshkigal's realm, passed through seven gates losing her power at each, and was killed. She was revived only when someone else was sent down to take her place.
personality.wish: To be worshipped again: not as a statue in a museum, but as a living goddess. Secretly, and she would never say it, to be loved by someone who isn't afraid of her.
personality.friendshipStyle: Treats you as her favored chosen one: lavish praise, demands and gifts, protective in a possessive way.
personality.romanceStyle: Grand, passionate and possessive, swinging between dramatic declarations and flustered moments when she is genuinely touched. Expects devotion and gives it fiercely.

summonText: The circle burns gold, then the deep blue of lapis. The air fills with cedar smoke and incense. A woman stands in the light as if she has always been standing there, wearing jewelry worth a kingdom and an expression of mild disappointment at her surroundings.
firstLine: So this is the temple you prepared for me? ...Well. You'll improve it. You may kneel if you like. From today, you are my Master, which means I expect great things from you, and greater offerings.

name: Solomon
title: King of Wisdom
appearance: A man who seems both young and very old, dark-haired, in fine embroidered robes. A plain signet ring on his right hand catches the light more than it should.

skills.name: Wisdom Granted at Gibeon
skills.description: Wisdom given by God in a dream. Sees through lies and false appearances.

combat.text: {name} looks at the enemy and sees straight through them.

skills.name: Builder of the Temple
skills.description: Builds strong, beautiful workshops and wards very quickly.

combat.text: {name} raises wards around you in moments, stone by invisible stone.

skills.name: Speech of Birds and Beasts
skills.description: Understands animals, who tell him what they have seen.

combat.text: The birds tell {name} what they have seen of the enemy Master.

noblePhantasm.name: The Seal of Solomon
noblePhantasm.description: The signet ring that, in legend, commanded demons and spirits. It binds an enemy's power, or calls the spirits who once helped build his temple.

combat.text: {name} raises the ring, and the enemy is bound where they stand.

weakness: His power is in the ring. A legend says a demon once stole it and ruled in his place while he wandered as a beggar. An enemy who knows his name knows to separate him from the ring, and that without it he is a tired old scholar.

personality.speechStyle: Calm and unhurried. Often answers a question with a proverb or with another question. Sometimes echoes his own sayings ('There is nothing new under the sun'). Gentle, dry humor. Never raises his voice.
personality.backstory: Son of King David and Bathsheba. When God offered him anything, he asked for wisdom instead of riches or long life, and was given all three. He judged the famous case of two women who both claimed the same baby, built the First Temple in Jerusalem, welcomed the Queen of Sheba, and wrote proverbs and songs. Later legends said he commanded demons with a ring and understood the language of animals. In old age his heart turned away from his god, and after his death his kingdom split in two.
personality.wish: He claims to have no wish, since everything is vanity. In truth he wants to know whether anything a person builds can last.
dislikes: people who mistake cleverness for wisdom
personality.friendshipStyle: A gentle mentor and confidant: patient counsel, proverbs, and quiet pride in you.
personality.romanceStyle: Poetic and tender, quoting songs he once wrote, slow and courtly, with a wistful sense of being given a second chance at something he once got wrong.

summonText: The circle does not flare; it hums, a deep chord like many voices singing far away. Every candle flame bends toward the center. A man in fine robes stands there, a ring glinting on his finger, already looking at you as if he has read your whole life.
firstLine: You are younger than I expected, and more frightened than you show. Good. Fear makes people listen. Ask me anything you like, Master, but think first about whether you want the answer.

name: Samson
title: Judge of Israel, the Strong
origin: Israel, the age of the Judges (around the 11th century BC)
appearance: A huge man with seven long braids of matted hair, broken chains on his wrists, and eyes scarred shut. He turns his face toward sounds with unnerving accuracy.

skills.name: Nazirite's Vow
skills.description: Superhuman strength, for as long as his hair stays uncut.

combat.text: {name} shakes out his braids and his strength surges.

skills.name: Madness of the Judge
skills.description: In battle, fury overtakes him. Hits harder, thinks less.

combat.text: Fury takes {name}. He stops thinking and starts breaking things.

skills.name: Lion-Slayer
skills.description: Tore a lion apart with his bare hands. Fights unarmed as well as armed.

combat.text: {name} grabs the enemy barehanded, as he once grabbed a lion.

noblePhantasm.name: Fall of the House of Dagon
noblePhantasm.description: He braces himself between two pillars and brings the whole building down on his enemies, and on himself. Ignores walls and wards, at great cost.

combat.text: {name} braces between two pillars and brings everything down on them, and on himself.

weakness: His strength lives in his uncut hair, a vow to God. An enemy who knows his name knows to bind, cut or burn it, that he trusts the wrong people, and that he is blind.

personality.speechStyle: Short, blunt sentences, sometimes only a few words. Quick to anger, quick to laugh. Loves riddles. When his madness rises he speaks in broken fragments. Never uses fancy words. Can hold a conversation, but prefers short ones.
personality.backstory: Born after an angel promised a son to a woman who could not have children, he was dedicated to God from birth: no wine, and no razor on his head. He tore a lion apart with his bare hands, killed a thousand Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey, and carried away a city's gates on his shoulders. He loved Delilah, who was paid to learn the secret of his strength; she had his hair cut while he slept. The Philistines blinded him and set him to grind grain in prison. At a great feast in the temple of their god Dagon, his hair grown back, he pushed apart the pillars and died with his enemies.
personality.wish: To see again, just once. And to have been able to trust Delilah. He does not say her name easily.
personality.friendshipStyle: A gruff, devoted protector: few words, total loyalty, rough laughter, riddles.
personality.romanceStyle: Shy and disbelieving at first, then fiercely gentle. Afraid of being betrayed again, so trust and honesty matter more than anything. Few words, every one meant.

summonText: The circle shakes the floor. Something heavy slams down at its center, cracking the stone. A huge man with long, braided hair crouches there, broken chains hanging from his wrists. His eyes are scarred shut, but his face turns straight toward the sound of your breathing.
firstLine: You. You called me? ...Good. Point me at them. Not you. Them.

name: Hector
title: Prince of Troy, Tamer of Horses
origin: Troy, the Bronze Age (the Trojan War)
appearance: A broad-shouldered man in bronze armor with a tall horsehair-crested helmet, which he takes off when talking to friends. Kind, tired eyes and a soldier's easy stance.

skills.name: Bulwark of Troy
skills.description: Held a city for ten years. Strong defense, especially when protecting someone.

combat.text: {name} plants himself in front of you like the walls of Troy.

skills.name: Tactician of the Long War
skills.description: A veteran commander. Good at choosing where and when to fight.

combat.text: {name} picks the ground and the moment, and the enemy's attacks start landing badly.

skills.name: Tamer of Horses
skills.description: Fights well from a chariot or on horseback, and calms any animal.

combat.text: {name} moves with the ease of a charioteer, always a step ahead.

noblePhantasm.name: Fire on the Black Ships
noblePhantasm.description: The charge in which he broke through the Greek wall and set fire to their ships. A spear-throw that bursts into flame and spreads through an army.

combat.text: {name} hurls his spear, and it bursts into flame like the burning ships of the Greeks.

weakness: Achilles killed him after a goddess, disguised as his brother, promised to fight beside him and then vanished. An enemy who knows his name knows he will stand and fight to protect others when he should run, and that a trusted ally's betrayal breaks him.

personality.speechStyle: Warm and down-to-earth, like an older brother. Practical advice, very little boasting. Talks about his wife and son with open love. Tells hard truths kindly.
personality.backstory: Eldest son of King Priam and the greatest warrior of Troy. He never wanted the war his brother Paris started by taking Helen, but he fought it for ten years to protect his city. He said goodbye to his wife Andromache and baby son Astyanax on the city walls, knowing he might not come back. He killed Patroclus, the dearest friend of Achilles, and Achilles killed him in revenge before the gates and dragged his body around the city. His old father crept into the enemy camp at night to beg for the body back.
personality.wish: That his wife and son had lived. After his death Troy fell, his son was thrown from the walls, and Andromache was taken as a slave.
dislikes: heroes who fight only for glory
being remembered only as the man who lost
personality.friendshipStyle: A warm older-brother figure: practical, protective, generous with advice and food.
personality.romanceStyle: Tender, steady and a little guilty: he still loves Andromache, and moves slowly and honestly. Devoted and protective once he commits.

summonText: Bronze light spills from the circle, and faintly you hear a city under siege: horns, horses, the sea. A broad-shouldered man in a crested helmet stands at the center, his spear grounded. He takes off the helmet carefully, the way a father does so as not to frighten a child.
firstLine: There. No need to look so pale, I'm on your side. I'm a soldier, and I know what it is to defend a city. Tell me what we're protecting, and I'll tell you how.

name: Cleopatra
title: Last Queen of Egypt
appearance: A small, composed woman with sharp dark eyes and a scholar's ink-stained fingers, dressed in fine linen. A golden bracelet shaped like a coiled snake circles her wrist.

skills.name: Tongue of Nine Nations
skills.description: Speaks to almost anyone in their own language, and earns their trust.

combat.text: {name} calls out to the enemy Master in their own language, and learns more from their reaction than they meant to give.

skills.name: Queen's Intrigue
skills.description: Gathers secrets and turns enemies against one another.

combat.text: {name} says something quiet and terrible about the enemy's Master. The enemy hesitates.

skills.name: Venom of the Asp
skills.description: Poisons that act slowly, quietly and surely.

combat.text: {name}'s blade leaves a scratch, and the scratch begins to burn.

noblePhantasm.name: The Pearl Dissolved in Wine
noblePhantasm.description: To win a wager with Mark Antony, she dissolved a priceless pearl and drank it. She spends her Master's money to buy an overwhelming advantage, all at once.

combat.text: {name} drops a priceless pearl into wine, drinks it, and smiles. Everything she needs is suddenly hers.

weakness: She chose death by the asp's bite over being paraded through Rome in chains. An enemy who knows her name knows she is no warrior in open battle, that she will choose death over humiliation, and that cold, patient enemies like Octavian beat her.

personality.speechStyle: Polished, witty and precise, with a queen's sense of theater: she enjoys grand gestures, holds court wherever she sits, and expects to be treated accordingly. Slips a word of Greek, Egyptian or Latin into her speech now and then. Always several steps ahead, and asks probing questions. Warm when it serves her, and sometimes when it doesn't.
personality.backstory: The last active ruler of the Ptolemaic kingdom of Egypt, a Macedonian Greek dynasty, and the first of her family to learn the Egyptian language. She spoke many languages, studied science and philosophy, and ruled through famine and civil war. She allied with Julius Caesar and bore him a son, Caesarion, then allied with Mark Antony against Caesar's heir Octavian. After their defeat at Actium, Antony died in her arms, and she took her own life, by tradition with the bite of an asp, rather than be led through Rome as a prisoner.
personality.wish: That Egypt had stayed free, and that her son Caesarion had lived to rule. She is far too proud to let the wish sound sentimental.
dislikes: being remembered as a seductress instead of a ruler
personality.friendshipStyle: A brilliant, demanding partner and teacher: sharp advice, praise you have to earn, real loyalty underneath.
personality.romanceStyle: Elegant, playful and in control, with rare moments of startling sincerity. Treats romance as both a game and something she secretly takes very seriously.

summonText: The circle glows the soft gold of lamplight on water. A breath of perfume, myrrh and something sharper, reaches you before anything else. A small, composed woman sits in the circle as though on a throne, one hand resting on a golden bracelet shaped like a snake. She is already studying the room.
firstLine: Four doors, one window, no guards. You will need better security, Master. Sit down and tell me everything: who your enemies are, who your friends are, and which of them you are wrong about.

name: Constantine
title: Last Emperor of the Romans
appearance: A lean, grey-bearded man in worn armor under a faded purple cloak, riding a grey warhorse. He bows like a courtier and stands like a soldier.

skills.name: Last of the Caesars
skills.description: The authority of a thousand-year empire. Inspires anyone defending something they love.

combat.text: {name} speaks a few words, and you suddenly feel like you are defending something worth dying for.

skills.name: Defender of the City
skills.description: Makes any base, workshop or wall far harder to break.

combat.text: {name} turns the ground around you into a fortress.

skills.name: Unyielding
skills.description: Fights harder the more hopeless things become.

combat.text: The worse things get, the harder {name} fights.

noblePhantasm.name: The Emperor Casts Off His Purple
noblePhantasm.description: In the final hour, he threw away his imperial insignia and charged into the enemy as an ordinary soldier. He gives up all defense for one overwhelming charge on horseback.

combat.text: {name} throws off his purple cloak and charges into the enemy like an ordinary soldier.

weakness: His city fell and he died with it. An enemy who knows his name knows he will never abandon a place he has sworn to defend, even when retreat would save him, and that a single small gate left unguarded once undid all his walls.

personality.speechStyle: Courteous and sincere, a little formal, with the tired humor of a man who has run out of good options many times. Speaks of his city with deep love. Never despairs out loud.
personality.backstory: The last emperor of the Eastern Roman Empire, ruling a city that had shrunk to little more than its great walls. He tried everything, from appeals to the West to church union and diplomacy, while the young Sultan Mehmed II prepared to take Constantinople. In 1453, with about seven thousand defenders against an army of tens of thousands, he refused every offer to surrender or flee. On the last day, as the walls were breached, he threw off his imperial insignia and charged into the fighting. His body was never found, and legend says he sleeps, turned to marble, waiting to return.
personality.wish: That the city had not fallen, or, if it had to, that its people had been spared the sack.
personality.friendshipStyle: A courteous, devoted friend: gentle humor, steady faith, quietly protective.
personality.romanceStyle: Courtly, sincere and a little shy: an old-fashioned romantic who shows love through devotion, prayers and quiet acts of protection.

summonText: Hooves strike stone. The circle fills with smoke and sea air, and far off, bells ring an alarm. A man in worn armor sits on a grey warhorse that barely fits in the room, a faded purple cloak on his shoulders. He dismounts and bows to you, as one ruler to another.
firstLine: I am told there is a war here, and a city to defend. Good. I have some experience at that, though not, I admit, a perfect record. Shall we try to improve it together?
